tool_args.rationale: Fit the four parameters of the verified barrier-modulated siphon numerically using all five observations. The target horizon matches the pilot, and the sink-gradient variation is sufficient to avoid the stated probe trigger.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad span is 2.0, well above the specified 0.08 ambiguity threshold.
The verified readout is an algebraic snapshot law, so a trajectory batch is not needed to identify it.
The matched barrier-siphon mechanism directly accounts for the observed drive and sink-gradient signatures.
